en: Psalms 88
A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite.

zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉利暗俄。

p.src: 1  LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

en: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
u.src: 1  LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

p.src: 2  Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

en: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
u.src: 2  Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

p.src: 3  For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

en: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
u.src: 3  For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

en: 88:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 4  I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

en: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
u.src: 4  I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

p.src: 5  set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

en: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
u.src: 5  set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

p.src: 6  You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

en: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
u.src: 6  You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

p.src: 7  Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

en: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
u.src: 7  Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

p.src: 8  You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

en: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
u.src: 8  You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

p.src: 9  My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

en: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.
u.src: 9  My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

p.src: 10  Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

en: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
u.src: 10  Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

p.src: 11  Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

en: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
u.src: 11  Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

p.src: 12  Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

en: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
u.src: 12  Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

p.src: 13  But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

en: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
u.src: 13  But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

p.src: 14  LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

en: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
u.src: 14  LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

p.src: 15  I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
u.src: 15  I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

p.src: 16  Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

en: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
u.src: 16  Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

p.src: 17  They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

en: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
u.src: 17  They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

p.src: 18  You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

en: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
u.src: 18  You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
